fast_local_agents.responsibility: Own mobile chat, owner memory, briefs and reminders. Relay reviewed specialist output to the owner.
Read approved calendars and family activities, identify conflicts and preparation needs, and request approval for changes.
Analyze scoped Home Assistant events, energy and host status. Keep actions behind existing deterministic Home Assistant and infrastructure controls.

briefing.name: Hverdagsbriefing
briefing.instruction: Brug kun verificerede, ejerspecifikke kilder. Opsummér dagens kalender, vigtige familieaktiviteter, opgaver og påmindelser, væsentlige Home Assistant-hændelser og softwareprojekter, der kræver min opmærksomhed. Højst fem handlingsrettede punkter. Angiv utilgængelige kilder. Udfør ingen handlinger og send ingen beskeder videre.
briefing.enable_after: Verify the existing morning n8n owner delivery edge, establish one schedule owner, approve the scoped sources and verify synthetic OpenBot notification on the owner's iPhone.

project_event_notice.route: Existing approved n8n ingress to an owner OpenBot signed signal
project_event_notice.enable_after: Verify authenticated GitHub ingress, configure the signed signal credential, and observe one synthetic event in the owner OpenBot history and on the owner's iPhone.
